objective: Tracking parameters are never stripped from source URLs. server/services/research/sources.ts ~L108 tests keys with /^(utm_|fbclid|gclid|mc_cid|mc_eid|ref)$/i, whose $ anchor makes utm_ match only a key literally named 'utm_'; normalizeUrl on '...?utm_source=x&utm_medium=y&id=3&fbclid=z' keeps utm_source and utm_medium. That normalized URL is the stored sourceUrl and is what summarize/countIndependentSources count, so one page cited twice with different campaign tags reads as two sources (CLAUDE.md §14: sources that are really one source are counted as one). Fix the rule to strip every utm_* key and keep content parameters.
expectedOutcome: utm_* and click-id parameters are stripped; content parameters are kept.
nonGoals: Changing which hosts count as independent

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/researchSourceUrlNormalize.test.ts: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign and fbclid are removed from a normalized URL.
A content parameter such as id=3 is kept, and the fragment is still dropped.
Existing research gate/submission tests pass and the repository typechecks.

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
